subject.title: fix(gateway): exit 0 on EADDRINUSE when healthy OpenClaw gateway is already running

question: Should OpenClaw continue this PR's probe-based exit-0 gateway lock handling after v2026.6.11 shipped exit-78 systemd behavior, or close/narrow it as superseded?
rationale: Current main and v2026.6.11 already solve the main systemd restart-loop with a different exit-code contract, while this branch changes auth/startup semantics and has a protected maintainer label.

options.title: Close As Superseded
options.body: Confirm the shipped systemd exit-78 behavior is the intended product direction and close this conflicted branch instead of reviving the exit-0 probe design.

options.title: Sponsor A Narrow Refresh
options.body: Ask for a rebase that keeps only a remaining non-systemd or authenticated-probe gap, fixes trusted-proxy source validation and IPv6 URLs, drops unrelated churn, and adds real supervisor proof.

options.title: Accept Probe Semantics
options.body: Explicitly choose exit-0 healthy-probe semantics despite the compatibility and auth-boundary risks, then require upgrade and real-behavior proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Close As Superseded
recommendation.body: Confirm the shipped systemd exit-78 behavior is the intended product direction and close this conflicted branch instead of reviving the exit-0 probe design.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the clearest current-main owner for the shipped lock recovery and trusted-proxy auth path that this PR now competes with.
